svg.title: Humming: Unified Quantization Representation and Composable Parameters
svg.desc: Quantization methods, low-precision formats and export formats converge through parsing, parameter mapping and tensor conversion into the Humming standard format. It contains common quantization parameters and normalized tensors. Weight numeric format, scale granularity and group size, scale type, zero point and secondary scale are composable, together with activation formats and static or dynamic quantization strategies. Three example configurations illustrate the shared representation; they do not imply automatic changes to the quantization scheme during loading. Combinations must satisfy data type and device compatibility requirements. The unified representation feeds Humming inference for Dense and MoE workloads.
